summary: First iteration full e2e test of BAFFE ROYALE: backend pytest 7/7 passed; frontend playwright e2e (Home -> Game -> countdown -> charge/release slap -> combo -> quit -> Result screen -> submit -> Leaderboard) all worked. Score increased from 0 to 4608, combo reached x4 with 4 charged slaps. Leaderboard correctly displayed submitted TEST_UI score and both 'tab-all'/'tab-daily' tabs functioned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); recommend migrating to lifespan handler.
submit_score persists current date in day_key based on server's local date.today() (no timezone); use UTC for consistency with created_at.
global_stats total_slaps is incremented by payload.kos (KO count), not actual slaps -- field name is misleading; consider renaming or also tracking real slap count.
No rate limiting / abuse protection on POST /api/scores (public, unauthenticated).
seed_data_creation: Created scores: TEST_USER (12345), TEST_DAILY (999), TEST_UI (via UI submission). All persisted in scores collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Use mousedown/wait_for_timeout(900)/mouseup pattern for charge-release on data-testid='slap-button'. Quit button is reliable shortcut to result. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_baffe_api.py covers POST/GET/daily/rank/stats and validations.
